concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-dispute-finalize-node]] - Braintree Node.js dispute finalization for `Open` disputes, restricted to merchants with Control Panel dispute access, requiring the finalize call to submit evidence to the banks and transition status to `Disputed`
warnings: Keep finalization scoped to disputes with status `Open` and preserve the resulting `Disputed` status exactly as stated by this page.
Preserve that the finalize call is required for evidence to be submitted; do not equate evidence upload, addition, removal, or preparation with submission.
Keep API availability qualified to merchants who can access disputes in the Braintree Control Panel.
Do not import or reconstruct the missing eligibility status from the separate Dispute Accept page; its damaged rendering is not evidence for finalization.
Treat the linked Dispute response page as navigation only; this source does not establish its unread full status schema or broader dispute lifecycle.
